assessments.reasoning: The questionnaire records time spent working exclusively in terms of average days and hours worked per day in the respondent's paid employment/occupation (Section 2, Part B, Questions 28 and 29). It does not contain a time use module or questions capturing time allocated across non-paid daily activities, domestic chores, or caregiving. Unpaid domestic and care work is only recorded as a reason for not seeking work or as a category of inactive status (Section 2, Part A, Questions 6 and 7).
